integrity: General algebraic proof accompanies finite reproducibility tests. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
limitations: Does not cover nonscalar affine transformations, one-sided congruences, or nonfield base rings.
Historical stronger group-with-constant-ideal theorems may imply portions of the result; absolute novelty is not independently certified.
scientific_scope: All two-sided congruences of scalar-affine self-map monoids of finite-field vector spaces, with all prime powers and positive ranks.
title: The full congruence lattice of finite scalar-affine transformation monoids
